def normalizeVector(v: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray:
    """Normalize a 3D vector to unit length.
    normalizeVector MUST return a unit-length vector or raise on zero length.
    [👤compose📚py💻compose🔖domain🔖validation🔖spatialmath🛠️normalizevector](composerepo://p/u/compose/b/l/py/f/compose.py/s/Domain/s/Validation/s/Spatial%20Math/d/i/normalizeVector)
    """
    length = numpy.linalg.norm(v)
    if length < 1e-10:
        return v
    return v / length
